players.product: copper-clad laminates with in-house electronic fibreglass yarn / fabric (incl. low-Dk, low-CTE and quartz specialty yarn) and RTF / HVLP copper foil for high-frequency, high-speed AI boards

quarterly_data.quarter: Kingboard Laminates HKEX circular: Revision of Annual Caps for and Renewal of Continuing (10-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Letter from the Board (circular dated 9 October 2026, EGM on 30 October 2026): the significant increase in 2026 sales to the Kingboard Holdings (KBH) Group was mainly due to the significant increase in the market selling price of laminates and related upstream materials; the average selling price in September 2026 was higher than the average for the eight months to 31 August 2026. Chemical purchases rose with higher laminate production volume and chemical prices. The board expects the Group's laminate production capacity to increase by approximately 10%, and attributes the copper price rise (from around USD13,000 per tonne early in 2026 to an all-time peak of USD14,533 per tonne in early August) partly to strong physical demand from AI infrastructure such as AI data center expansions and power grid builds. It anticipates higher demand from the KBH Group as it expands PCB capacity: KBH's total PCB capacity was 20 million square feet per month at 30 June 2026, and it has brought in 600,000 square feet of additional monthly multi-layered PCB capacity in Vietnam from Q4 2026 (about 3% more than at end-2025).
quarterly_data.figure: Group laminate production capacity to rise approximately 10%; KBH PCB capacity 20 million square feet per month, plus 600,000 square feet per month in Vietnam from Q4 2026
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: customer (laminates and upstream materials for its PCB production)
